title: Temperature Clamp All
prompt: A temperature chart must keep every reading inside a visible range. Write a function that returns a new array where values below min become min and values above max become max.

explanation.beginner:
Example: temperatureClampAll([-15,5,30], -10, 25) produces [-10,5,25]. Apply both bounds so values inside the interval remain unchanged and outliers move to the nearest permitted bound.

Compare “keeps values inside the range”: input [[-10,5],-10,25] produces [-10,5]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
